test_SubgraphMatcher: test the SubgraphMatcher class that matches subgraphs in a torch.fx.Graph against a pattern graph
build_SubgraphMatcher_match: build a SubgraphMatcher instance and call match to find all matching subgraphs in a target graph
test_InternalMatch: test the InternalMatch dataclass that stores anchor nodes, node mappings, and placeholder nodes from a subgraph match
build_SubgraphMatcher_match_output: build a SubgraphMatcher with match_output enabled to include the output node as part of the matched pattern
build_SubgraphMatcher_match_placeholder: build a SubgraphMatcher with match_placeholder enabled to treat placeholder nodes as concrete matches rather than wildcards
